final.why: Skip this restock. Existing inventory and carrying-cost exposure are substantial; although G00327e80 has positive mature net, its audit has no observed unit IDs across either completed window and lacks complete coverage. Without evidence of a binding guard cut and a nonfalling six-hour book, the audit and cohort do not justify an increase.

last_decisions.reason: The formula proposes a broad restock, but current stock is already 170 units costing 127.2m, including 65 mattresses and 58 sofas/chairs, while balance is 123.1m. Earlier decisions show broad additions were avoided; G00327e80 has 3 units on hand and has sold well historically, but the required audit does not support buying more: its two completed windows (1794084264 and 1794085360) report no observed unit IDs bought, sold, remaining, or exited; coverage is therefore missing, not evidence of zero sales. The cohort has 51 mature sales with known costs and one linked refund, net 13,481,826 or 264,349.53 per sale, with no missing cost or warranty data. Positive mature net alone is insufficient: the binding guard target and six-hour-old book evidence are not supplied, so do not increase its target. Avoid the formula’s extensive additions and carrying costs.
